thread:
deploy-bot: HOLD - preflight found env-parity drift. staging configmap 'service-config' contains payment.timeout_ms=12000 and MIGRATION_LOCK=false; prod missing both. KMS alias differs (staging: dev-kms-zyx, prod: kms-zyx). Blocking promotion to prod.

maya (eng-release): who added payment.timeout_ms? any PR link?

omar (platform): PR #4899 (feature/payments-retry) added the key last week. It was meant to be toggled but the config key landed.

sophie (infra): KMS alias change came from my dev rotation branch; I missed excluding prod. I can backfill the alias and patch the configmap.

james (qa): note: MIGRATION_LOCK=false will run migrations on startup. If prod never saw that, we risk schema mismatch. Need to monitor migration jobs closely.

tara (release): options: 1) patch prod config to match staging and proceed with canary, 2) pin image and skip new keys, 3) postpone to next window. Window closes in ~1.5h.

sophie (infra): I suggest a minimal patch: add MIGRATION_LOCK=false and payment.timeout_ms=12000 to prod configmap, then start 10% canary for 10m. I'll run a dry-run diff first.

omar (platform): +1. Abort criteria: error rate >5% or migration job failure. Update release notes with manual alias fix and PR #4899.

maya (eng-release): add rollback playbook and tag release 'skip-rollback=false'. Also open a follow-up to prevent KMS alias drift across envs.

ops-bot: kubectl get cm service-config -n prod -o yaml -> payment.timeout_ms: <absent>

sophie (infra): dry-run patch:
- payment.timeout_ms: <absent>
+ payment.timeout_ms: "12000"
- MIGRATION_LOCK: <absent>
+ MIGRATION_LOCK: "false"
Applying in 4m unless objections.

james (qa): I'll watch migrations and run payments smoke tests on canary. Report back in 12m.

ops-bot: configmap patched in prod by sophie (infra) at 3135792600.

james (qa): canary healthy at 9m, no migration failures, checkout flow OK.

omar (platform): rolling out to 100% now.

maya (eng-release): release notes updated with the patch, KMS alias normalization, and rollback steps.

tara (release): hold cleared. marking this action in the release log and creating follow-up ticket to enforce alias whitelist for prod. :white_check_mark:
